description.en: A native DSH team for multi-harness collaboration and ongoing improvement: team setup, automatic first-run and weekly workflows, public-tool sharing and reuse, pause controls, and results in the original session. Actual members, the Legion core and models require separate configuration and remain subject to existing permissions. Scheduling or delivery does not establish successful evolution.
description.zh: DSH 原生多 Harness 协同进化战队：原生组队后自动安排首次和每周工作，支持公开工具互用、暂停及原会话核对。实际成员、军团核心与模型需另行配置，沿用原有权限；任务安排或投递不等于成功进化。
